items.difficulty_reason: 14 行陈述（27 行证明）、specialization 与 proper 推前交换：生成元上构造刻画、推前 0/d[Z'] 二分经平坦拉回交换引理搬到一般纤维、closed-in-X-gysin 引理搬到闭纤维、逐情形拼合。2 处引用全具名，末步 Gysin 取值 clearly 一语（闭纤维标准事实、软点非 verbatim omit），收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-specialization-proper-pushforward (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 541-554

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Test the commutativity on generators given by integral closed subschemes dominating the valuation ring, where both composite maps are determined by the defining property of the specialization map on such subschemes, split the proper pushforward of the whole subscheme into the dimension-drop and generically-finite cases by the definition of pushforward on cycles, transport the dichotomy to the generic fibres by commutation of proper pushforward with flat pullback, transport it to the closed fibres by the Gysin base-change lemma applied to the diagram of closed fibres, and match the two composites case by case (source lines 556-582)
